description: Jira · Daily progress, in a tab of its own (opened from Jira stories and the Jira updates bell): what moved in Jira day by day — stories closed, new, reopened, moved, touched, by whom — over the last 7, 14, 30 or 60 days, the stuck ones, copied as text (resources/js/jiraProgress.js).

prog.description: The days, their numbers and stories, the totals, the people (jiraProgress.progressOf).

stuck.description: Open stories with no change for 5+ days, quietest first.

stuckRead.description: The stuck stories could be read.

more.description: More stories changed than were read (the first 1,000).

sel.description: The day shown in detail (YYYY-MM-DD; '' = the latest).

workOnly.description: Working days only (weekends left out of the charts).

copied.description: Said once a summary is copied.

from.description: The window's first day (YYYY-MM-DD): chosen, or the last days' first.

to.description: The window's last day (YYYY-MM-DD): chosen, or today.

custom.description: From – To chosen (else the last 7, 14, 30 or 60 days).

stuckMore.description: More stuck stories than were read (the first 300).
